description: Get the signed-in person's personal Typeza invite link (https://typeza.ai/i/...), a share text with the link in it, and invitee_gets, one sentence on what the invited person gets. Call it when the person wants to invite someone, for example a partner, friend or colleague, to see how they relate. The person sends the link themselves: Typeza sends no email. The link is the same every time and works for any number of people. Needs their Typeza account connected with the relationships permission.
name: get_my_invite_link
title: Get my invite link
